acceptance_author: independent Codex verifier; may not implement
problem: Cloudflare Turnstile is a redundant flow blocker before the separately enforced emailed-code verification step.
approved_wrong_state: Production-main client refuses verify-start without a Turnstile token, its proxy rejects that request, and /upload loads and renders Turnstile authority.
required_state: A browser with a syntactically valid email can request the verification code without a Turnstile token.
verify-start neither requires nor transmits a Turnstile token.
The /upload page, component, entry helper and intake proxy contain no Turnstile script, widget, environment authority, verification call or bot-check error copy.
verify-check still requires the emailed challenge token and entered code; no verified session is minted outside successful code checking.
The server-only signed proxy, request idempotency, client-IP forwarding, error/rate mapping and body cap remain.
All later intake, upload, review and publication behavior remains outside the change and unchanged.
not_authorized: push, preview, deployment or environment changes
changes to backend email-code verification, rate limits, signing, uploads, review or publication law
editing the frozen contract or gate
